<div class="card-body">
'''Arcona''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊＊＊アルコーナ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">“夜間状態”では戦闘力＋1。その位置カード上で起こった戦闘から“リアクション”として移動して逃げることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Arcona-PSA-164793233.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ウナット・ポルは典型的なアルコーナの男性だ。この種族には珍しく、彼は塩分の摂取を避けてきた。同盟軍に荷担していることで知られる偵察兵。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Arcona.

'''Card text:'''
Power +1 under "nighttime conditions." May move away from a battle that occurred at that location card as a "react."

'''Lore:'''
Unut Poll is a typical male Arcona. Unusually for this species, he has avoided salt. A scout known to cooperate with the Alliance.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Arcona]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
